title: Combining Synthetic and Real Data for Low-Resource Historical OCR: A Manchu Case Study
abstract: arXiv:2609.11495v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Manchu, now critically endangered, was one of the principal languages of the Qing empire (1636-1912), and its extensive archival record is increasingly digitized but remains difficult to search and analyze at scale. Previous work showed that vision-language models (VLMs) trained only on synthetic Manchu word images can reach 87.4% word accuracy on real Qing manuscripts and prints, leaving a substantial synthetic-to-real gap. This study examines how synthetic and real historical training data should be combined for low-resource OCR. Using 60,000 synthetic and 20,306 real historical word images, we evaluate three pretrained VLMs and a compact convolutional recurrent neural network (CRNN) under four regimes: synthetic-only, real-only, joint synthetic-real, and sequential synthetic-to-real training, following a common checkpoint-selection and archival evaluation protocol. translated_title: 结合合成数据与真实数据的低资源历史OCR：满文案例研究
translated_abstract: 满语现已被列为极度濒危语言，它曾是清帝国（1636-1912年）的主要语言之一，其庞大的档案记录正日益数字化，但仍难以进行大规模的检索与分析。先前的研究表明，仅使用合成满文单词图像训练的视觉语言模型（VLM）在真实的清代手稿和印刷品上可达到87.4%的词准确率，但仍存在显著的合成到真实数据的性能差距。本研究探讨了在低资源OCR任务中应如何组合合成数据与真实历史训练数据。我们使用60,000张合成单词图像和20,306张真实历史单词图像，在四种训练模式（仅合成数据、仅真实数据、合成与真实联合训练、以及由合成到真实的顺序训练）下评估了三个预训练视觉语言模型和一个紧凑型卷积循环神经网络（CRNN），并遵循统一的检查点选择与档案评估协议。引入真实训练图像使领先配置的性能提升至……
tldr: 本研究以濒危语言满文为案例，系统评估了仅合成、仅真实、联合及顺序训练四种模式下视觉语言模型与CRNN在低资源历史OCR中的表现，证明引入真实历史数据可显著缩小合成到真实的性能差距。
en_tdlr: Using Manchu as a case study, this work systematically evaluates four training regimes—synthetic-only, real-only, joint, and sequential synthetic-to-real—for low-resource historical OCR, showing that incorporating real historical data substantially narrows the synthetic-to-real performance gap.
